method: Independent feasibility judging: every idea re-read from the generator shards and scored on (1) minimal-experiment cost (tier T1 = frozen-model inference or cached-prediction analysis only; T2 = small training runs, synthetic rendering, or light collection; T3 = gated on hardware, clinical experts, human recruitment at scale, or pretraining-scale compute), (2) whether the stated falsification is actually runnable with public assets, (3) architecture-permutation risk (recipe ported onto a new model without a belief at risk), and (4) vagueness (no crisp failure criterion). Judge A's shard was consulted only after forming verdicts; agreements and disagreements are recorded, not reconciled. No novelty is verified anywhere; every prior_art_risk flag is this judge's unverified hypothesis. No citations are asserted.
epistemic_status: NO verified novelty claims. All prior-art remarks are unverified judge hypotheses. No fabricated citations.

kill_ids.reason: Decisive falsification requires counterfactual pretraining of promptable segmenters from MAE vs contrastive inits (multi-day multi-GPU); the proposed cheap precursor (phenotype overlap between MAE probes and SAM errors) cannot discriminate inheritance from convergence. No cheap kill exists; park until a funded training slot exists.

Efficiency recipe wearing a hypothesis costume: 'easy prompts saturate at shallower depth' is near-certain, and confirming it yields a router paper rather than a falsified belief. Architecture-permutation (early-exit ported to SAM).

Curriculum-order effect for sequential adapters is noise-dominated: settling it honestly needs many seeds x orders x domains, expensive relative to a generic payoff. Permutation of curriculum learning onto adapters.

Near-tautological: a global threshold provably cannot express spatially varying costs, so the experiment only measures a gap whose size is dictated by invented cost maps. No belief at risk; a measurement, not a hypothesis.
Known-critique restatement: multi-label re-evaluations of top-1 benchmarks already exist and the fast experiment literally reuses them. Nothing left to falsify cheaply that prior work has not.

Boundary-vs-region metric divergence is established practice (boundary-quality metrics exist for exactly this reason); residual novelty (human editing-utility link) is a user study bolted onto a known result.
Reporting FPR-at-high-TPR alongside AUROC is already standard in OOD papers; the claimed reordering is largely documented. Low information per unit work despite trivial cost.
Attention-faithfulness failure is a heavily published area; the proposed occlusion-agreement test replicates known designs. Killed as redundant, not infeasible.
The decisive equalized SSL-vs-supervised comparison is pretraining-scale compute; small paired runs cannot settle an explicitly scale-dependent claim. Feasibility fail for this project's budget.

Same pretraining-scale wall as C-056, and public data-curation competitions already run this exact ablation at multiple scales; no cheap decisive kill is available to us and the field is actively measuring it.
Direct port of the famous emergence-is-a-metric-artifact result to vision benchmarks; permutation with high prior-art risk and no new falsification design.
Cross-threat non-transfer of adversarial defenses is a well-established negative result; re-running the matrix is cheap but redundant.
Vague and human-gated: 'trained evaluators find more failures under adaptive budgets' is near-tautological, evaluator-skill-confounded, and has no crisp falsification criterion.
